2607.28027.title: VISA: A Structured Description Protocol for Agent-Based Simulation Models Towards Machine Reproducibility
2607.28027.paper_summary: Agent-based models (ABMs) are difficult to reproduce: their behavior is spread across prose narratives, platform-specific code, and implicit assumptions, so that two readers routinely reconstruct different models from the same documentation. We present VISA, a structured, symbol-based description protocol that specifies a model in eight interconnected tables---four at the agent level (Agent, Variable, Sensing, Internal Function) and four at the model level (Associated Data, Input/Output, Schedule, Validation)---under the principle of minimality with completeness. VISA makes a model machine-parseable and unambiguous via two artifacts: nineteen executable consistency rules that turn model validity into a checkable property, and three reusable LLM-executable skills (authoring, checking, and code generation) that operationalize the full author--check--code--reproduce loop. We validate the protocol on three external, independently authored ABMs spanning three platforms: we reproduce two cross-language (NetLogo to Python) directly from their VISA specifications, and we capture a third, an industrial AnyLogic model, in eight tables (passing all nineteen rules) while honestly demarcating where reproduction is blocked by a proprietary movement library and unavailable data---itself a transparency contribution. VISA moves the reproduction barrier from the model, where it is invisible, to a named, localized dependency, where it is actionable.
2607.28027.paper_summary_zh: 代理基於模型（ABMs）難以重現：它們的行為分散在散文敘述、特定平台的代碼和隱含假設中，以至於兩位讀者經常從相同的文檔中重建出不同的模型。我們提出VISA，一種結構化的基於符號的描述協議，通過八個相互連結的表格來指定模型——四個在代理層級（代理、變量、感知、內部功能）和四個在模型層級（相關數據、輸入/輸出、時間表、驗證）——遵循最小性與完整性的原則。VISA使模型可機器解析且明確無誤，通過兩個工件：十九條可執行的一致性規則，將模型有效性轉化為可檢查的屬性，以及三個可重用的LLM可執行技能（創作、檢查和代碼生成），使完整的創作--檢查--代碼--重現循環得以運作。我們在三個外部、獨立創作的ABMs上驗證該協議，涵蓋三個平台：我們直接從它們的VISA規範重現兩個跨語言（從NetLogo到Python），並在八個表格中捕捉到第三個，即一個工業AnyLogic模型（通過所有十九條規則），同時誠實地標明重現受到專有運動庫和不可用數據的阻礙——這本身就是一種透明度的貢獻。VISA將重現障礙從模型中移動到一個具名的、本地化的依賴項，使其可操作。
2607.28027.author: Zhou He et.al.
